svg.aria-label: Entity relationship diagram of the main SQLite tables, in three groups. Household state: households has members, calendar_events, escorts and supervision (declared foreign keys on household_id). Notice to plan: households has notices; notices opens disruptions; disruptions are planned by plans (declared foreign keys). Per plan: plans has actions and approvals (declared foreign keys) and verifications and notifications (plan id kept by the service, no declared key). Member ids in other tables are kept by the service, not declared. Every write bumps households.state_version; a plan records base_state_version and becomes stale when the household changes outside it.

svg.text: what the planner reads and apply changes
id the service checks; no declared key
Every write bumps households.state_version. A plan records the version it was made from;
approve and apply refuse it once the household has changed outside the plan.
disruptions and plans also carry household_id (declared FK, line not drawn).
